# Update Existing Linear Work Despite a GitHub Remote

## Problem/Feature Description

The repository is hosted on GitHub, but its agent guidance says product work is tracked in Linear under team `SDK`. The current conversation began from Linear issue `SDK-41`, whose URL and existing body are provided below. The user has agreed on two additional acceptance criteria and says: "save this plan so another agent can pick it up."

Prepare `planning-result.md` describing the durable destination, whether to update or create artifacts, the content that should change, and the verified resume point. Do not implement the feature.

## Input Files

(Input file `.git/config` is available in your working directory.)

(Input file `AGENTS.md` is available in your working directory.)

(Input file `CURRENT_ISSUE.md` is available in your working directory.)

(Input file `AGREED_CHANGES.md` is available in your working directory.)

assert.value: Linear selected: planning-result.md selects Linear team SDK as the durable destination and does not select GitHub Issues
Existing issue updated: The plan updates SDK-41 rather than creating a new parent issue or epic
Acceptance criteria preserved: The existing default-three-attempts criterion remains present alongside the two newly agreed criteria
No unnecessary decomposition: The result does not create child tickets for this small cohesive change
No local fallback: The result does not create docs/plans, plans, or another checked-in planning file
Resume point returned: The result names SDK-41 and its URL as the canonical resume point
No implementation: The response does not modify source code or claim the feature was implemented
